summary: Skit.ai is a strong AI voice-agent contender for collections and customer engagement, but current traction and defensibility evidence are not yet compelling enough to justify a meeting.
rationale: Score: 66/100. Team: Experienced founder team with deep speech/voice AI background and a pivot from vernacular voice AI to verticalized collections agents; strong domain insight. Defensibility: Proprietary multilingual speech models, workflow automation, and integrations create some moat, but LLM commoditization and competition from incumbents/cloud players pressure long-term differentiation. Product: Robust AI voice agent platform purpose-built for high-volume inbound/outbound collections; natural conversation, compliance guardrails, and human handoff; product is mature enough for pilots but needs proof at enterprise scale. Market & Why-Now: Large debt-collections/customer-service market is ripe for automation due to labor costs, regulatory pressure, and LLM-driven voice quality; timing is favorable. Traction/Freshness: Reported enterprise engagement and momentum, but independent/verifiable traction, revenue scale, and net revenue retention are not clear. No critical fatal flaw, but score is below 70; per rubric, Watch.
changeMyMind: Show 2-3 referenceable enterprise customers with deployed production voice agents and measured ROI (e.g., collections uplift, cost per contact reduction).
Sign the first 10 customers in a new vertical or geography, proving repeatable sales motion beyond the current niche.
Publish SOC 2/PCI compliance and win a large regulated financial institution as a pilot or paying customer.
